title: Sum of the First N Numbers
description: Calculate the sum of the numbers from 1 to 100 using a for loop.
hints: Initialize i = 1 (not 0) because you want to sum from 1 to 100
The condition is i <= 100 to include the 100
solutionExplanation: The for loop starts at i = 1 and goes up to 100 inclusive (i <= 100). In each iteration we accumulate the value of i in suma. The formula n*(n+1)/2 gives 5050, confirming the result.

title: Asterisk Triangle with Nested for Loop
description: Draw a triangle of 5 rows using nested for loops: 1 asterisk in row 1, 2 in row 2, up to 5 in row 5.
hints: The outer loop: for (int f = 1; f <= filas; f++)
The inner loop prints f asterisks: for (int a = 0; a < f; a++)
Print System.out.println() at the end of each outer row
solutionExplanation: The outer for loop goes through each row from 1 to 5. The inner for loop prints as many asterisks as the row number indicates. Without spaces (print instead of println) and a line break at the end of each row.

title: Prime Number Detector with Optimized for Loop
description: Determine whether a number is prime using a for loop that only checks divisors up to the square root of the number. Display all primes from 2 to 50.
hints: A number is prime if it is only divisible by 1 and by itself
Checking divisors only up to Math.sqrt(n) is sufficient and faster
Keep a counter of found divisors or use a boolean
solutionExplanation: The outer for loop goes through each candidate from 2 to 50. The inner for loop checks divisors from 2 up to the square root of n: if it finds a divisor, the number is not prime and we exit with break. The square root optimization drastically reduces the number of comparisons.
